description: Taqvim license allow-list. Policy: docs/adr/0003-license-policy.md. 'licenses' covers Maven dependencies, per scope: runtime (shipped), build (annotation processors, lint checks, compiler plugins), test (unit/instrumented/benchmark only). 'dataLicenses' covers data files bundled with the app or used to validate it (docs/adr/0039-cc-by-data-license.md); those are never code and never enter the dependency graph.

dataLicenses.note: CLDR locale data. The license text is bundled verbatim and the About entry carries the copyright notice.
Public-domain dedication; usable for bundled data without conditions.
Works without copyright (Natural Earth, NOAA, USNO, US federal agencies).

No license is granted or needed: only facts are used and the app recomputes them. The About entry names and links the publication, which is the citation; docs/PROVENANCE.md carries the full reference.

dataLicenses.adr: docs/adr/0039-cc-by-data-license.md (bundled data only; never a code dependency)
dataLicenses.note: Attribution-only; the About > Data sources entry carries creators, year, source link, license name and URI, disclaimer and the note on modifications (CC BY 4.0 section 3(a)).

overrides.note: POM declares 'BSD style' + 'Public Domain'; upstream license text is the MIT license (verified 2026-09-13).
